eglise.name: L'église : la nef · Church: the Nave
eglise.alt: Inside the village church, painted in ink and gouache: a model ship hangs over the nave, a carved pulpit, a statue with a pigeon, a little knight with a quest map beside the collection plate, a mother duck leading candle-carrying ducklings, a dancing candle, a wedding party in the aisle, an old parishioner arranging sunflowers, a stained-glass window and pews; a door on the left opens onto the sunny square and an open side door on the right leads back to the village lane. In the apse behind the wedding party a tall oak door stands open on the choir, with its organ pipes and green banner.

doors.label: Le parvis
doors.hint: Step out onto the church square

doors.label: La sacristie
doors.hint: Through the little blue door to the sacristy

doors.label: Le chœur
doors.hint: Through the tall open oak door in the apse behind the wedding party, into the choir

parvis.name: Le parvis et le clocher · Forecourt and Bell Tower
parvis.alt: The church square painted in ink and gouache: a stone arcade with a bronze bell, a ginger cat with a bell collar, a painted Easter egg on the steps, a valley of churches, domes and a round tower, a family waving, a holy-water stoup and the carved church portal with its oak door.

doors.label: La nef
doors.hint: Back inside the church through the oak door

sacristie.name: La sacristie · Sacristy
sacristie.alt: The sacristy painted in ink and gouache: the open blue door back to the nave, a small picture of a sacristy, a black cassock with sunglasses on a peg, cruets on a tray, an altar server holding a candle, the tall oak armoire, a folded amice, a hanging censer, a box of incense and the sacristan lighting candles.

doors.label: La nef
doors.hint: Back through the blue door to the nave

doors.label: La chapelle
doors.hint: Through the arched doorway to the Lady Chapel

zooms.label: l'armoire
zooms.hint: Open the armoire to see the vestments

armoire.name: L'armoire · Cupboard
armoire.alt: The open oak armoire from the sacristy: a purple stole on the left door, a long white alb on its hanger, a green chasuble, a white-and-gold dalmatic above a sleeping Dalmatian puppy, and a lacy white surplice on the right.

chapelle.name: La chapelle de la Vierge · Lady Chapel
chapelle.alt: A blue Lady Chapel with a white statue of the Virgin between two blue lily banners and branched candle stands. Children in white carry a sunflower garland past a girl in yellow lighting candles, three choirboys sing at a lectern, and in the pews an old woman counts her rosary beads while a family of three prays the rosary together. A stained-glass window shows the Annunciation, a framed picture of a cathedral hangs on the left wall, a brown scapular hangs on a hook and a tall window looks out on a church and fields. The archway on the left leads back to the sacristy; the wooden door on the right opens into the sanctuary.

doors.label: La sacristie
doors.hint: Back through the archway to the sacristy

doors.label: Le sanctuaire
doors.hint: The dark wooden door on the right, into the sanctuary

sanctuaire.name: Le sanctuaire · The sanctuary
sanctuaire.alt: The sanctuary of the village church on a Saturday afternoon, getting ready for First Communion. On the left an altar server kneels among spilled blue hymnbooks, the gray-haired sacristan holds up a round white wafer beside a gold plate of wafers, a girl in a white Communion dress and veil twirls, and Père Antoine rehearses from his notes. In the middle a bellhop in red pushes a brass luggage cart of white lilies to the stone altar; behind it a woman dusts the gilded tabernacle. On the right a girl server polishes a gold chalice, a boy holds the tall processional cross and a young woman reads at the lectern from a big book. A rose window and blue lily banners hang above. The open door on the left goes back to the Lady Chapel, the stone steps at the front lead down to the crypt, and the arch on the right opens onto the side aisle with the confessional.

doors.label: La chapelle
doors.hint: The dark wooden door on the left, back to the Lady Chapel

doors.label: La crypte
doors.hint: The stone steps going down at the front, to the crypt

doors.label: Le bas-côté
doors.hint: The stone arch on the right, to the side aisle and the confessional

crypte.name: La crypte · The crypt
crypte.alt: A low vaulted crypt with thick stone pillars on Heritage Day. A boy in a yellow sweater stands at the foot of the stone steps, a guide in green points to an old wooden staff in a lit niche, and a faded fresco shows a saint in blue holding a white lamb. Père Antoine raises his hand to bless an old couple. In the middle a mime in a red beret kneels with folded hands to pray under a red hanging lamp, and a second mime lays white flowers before a small gilded reliquary on a stone altar. In front of them lies the low stone tomb of an archbishop, his carved figure asleep with miter and folded hands. On the right two visitors admire a carved young saint holding a palm branch on a pillar, and a tiny mouse peeks out at its foot. The stone steps on the left lead back up to the sanctuary.

doors.label: Le sanctuaire
doors.hint: The stone steps going up on the left, back to the sanctuary

confessionnal.name: Le bas-côté · The side aisle
confessionnal.alt: A side aisle with wooden pews. A girl with chocolate on her face holds a chocolate bunny beside her grandmother, a woman wraps a shivering gray kitten in her red scarf, and two little brothers hug while their teacher smiles. A boy holds the pieces of a broken flowerpot as a mime in a red beret opens his arms to forgive him. A carved oak confessional with purple curtains stands against the wall, a painter on a stepladder retouches a small framed landscape, and a boy on a bench holds peaches from a basket next to a sleeping ginger cat. The arch at the back leads to the baptistery; the arch on the right goes back to the sanctuary.

doors.label: Le sanctuaire
doors.hint: The stone arch on the right, back to the sanctuary

doors.label: Le baptistère
doors.hint: The low arch at the far end, to the baptistery

baptistere.name: Le baptistère · The baptistery
baptistere.alt: A round baptistery on a happy baptism day. On the left the godmother laughs under a dripping yellow umbrella, and a mime in a red beret tosses pink and blue sugared almonds to two delighted children. In the middle Père Antoine pours water from a silver jug into the big stone font, and a ginger cat sniffs a silver jar on a little table. On the right a grandfather holds a baby in a white christening gown who waves a yellow bath sponge, and the godfather runs in out of breath with a tall white candle. The arch on the left goes back to the side aisle with the confessional; the open arch on the right leads out to the churchyard. The round domed room itself, with its little dove window above the font, is the baptistery.

doors.label: Le bas-côté
doors.hint: The low arch on the left, back to the side aisle

doors.label: Le cimetière
doors.hint: The small open side door at the back right, out to the churchyard

cimetiere.name: Le cimetière · The churchyard
cimetiere.alt: A calm, sunny churchyard beside the church with tall cypress trees and green hills beyond. A woman in a blue cardigan plants fresh flowers on a grave next to a watering can with a robin on it. A stonemason brushes moss off a gray headstone while a girl traces its face with her finger and her grandfather looks on; an old man rests on a bench in the sun. A small ivy-covered family vault with a boy beside it stands at the back, a gardener rakes the gravel between the rows, and a tall plain stone cross on stepped pedestal stands by the gate. The side door in the church wall on the left leads back to the baptistery, and the open iron gate at the back right, with a dark hearse parked quietly beyond it, leads on to the quiet corner by the churchyard gate, and from there out to the village.

doors.label: Le baptistère
doors.hint: The small side door in the church wall on the left, back to the baptistery

doors.label: Le portail
doors.hint: Through the iron gate at the back right, to the quiet corner by the churchyard gate

choeur.name: Le chœur · The choir
choeur.alt: The choir of the village church during Sunday Mass. On the left a gray-haired cantor leads the singing from her booklet, the priest in a green chasuble raises the host above the altar as a server rings a little bell, and a girl in a yellow cardigan carries a basket of bread and apples. In the middle a mime in a red beret swings a smoking censer, a woman stands by a tall green banner, a second mime urges the choir on and a third flings his arms up singing. On the right singers in white robes sing in the oak stalls under the big pipe organ, an older man carries a gold plate of wafers and a man in a gray sweater waits at a reading stand. A mouse peeks out by the stalls. A tall oak door behind the cantor stands open on the candle-lit pews of the nave, the small arch on the left leads to the candle-lit Mercy chapel, and the oak door on the right opens into the treasury.

doors.label: La nef
doors.hint: Through the tall open oak door on the left, behind the cantor, back to the nave

doors.label: La Miséricorde
doors.hint: The small stone arch on the left, to the Mercy chapel

doors.label: Le trésor
doors.hint: The heavy oak door on the right, to the treasury

tresor.name: Le trésor · The treasury
tresor.alt: The church treasury on restoration day. On the left a woman pats a gold plate dry, a nun closes a tiny gold box, a mime in a green beret turns a crate into a bookshelf, another gives two thumbs up beside a little white angel, and a third covers his mouth guiltily. In the middle a mime paints gold on the halo of a wooden king statue, a restorer on a ladder paints the carved altarpiece, an old woman embroiders a white banner with wheat, grapes and a chalice, and a cat sleeps in a basket. On the right a mime polishes a carved reading stand, a jeweler holds up a gold lidded cup and a bookbinder works on a big red book beside an old chest. The oak door on the left goes back to the choir and the blue door on the right opens into the parish hall.

doors.label: Le chœur
doors.hint: The heavy oak door on the left, back to the choir

doors.label: La salle paroissiale
doors.hint: The light-blue door at the back right, to the parish hall

misericorde.name: La chapelle de la Miséricorde · The Mercy chapel
misericorde.alt: A small candle-lit chapel in the evening. On the left a girl shields a candle flame, a priest in a purple stole raises his hand over a kneeling man under a painting of a shepherd freeing a little white lamb from the brambles, and an old man wraps his red scarf around a tired young man and gives him a sandwich. A woman in a headscarf prays in a pew. On the right a mime in a red beret kneels before a golden sunburst monstrance under a glowing round window, a mime in a shiny gold beret scrubs a slate clean, an old woman lights candles at a side altar, and a mime with cookie crumbs on his face holds an empty cookie tin. The arch on the left opens toward the saints' chapel and the arch on the right goes back to the choir.

doors.label: Le chœur
doors.hint: The stone arch on the right, back to the choir

doors.label: La chapelle des saints
doors.hint: The low arched door on the left, to the saints' chapel

salle.name: La salle paroissiale · The parish hall
salle.alt: The bright parish hall on a Saturday. On the left a girl points at a poster of bread and a chalice, an old priest rests his hand on a smiling boy holding a little bottle of oil, and a teenage girl holds a white candle with her sponsor's hand on her shoulder. In the middle a mime in a red beret pours water over a baby doll in a basin, a young man studies at a back table, and a mime in a green beret blesses the snack table. On the right a mime helps a little boy ring a hand bell, another holds a piece of bread in his cupped hands, a banner shows seven candles, a big globe stands by a tray of red church models, and a little boy rides a hobby horse beside his godmother in a red coat. A goldfish swims on the windowsill. The oak door on the left goes back to the treasury.

doors.label: Le trésor
doors.hint: The heavy oak door on the left, back to the treasury

saints.name: La chapelle des saints · The saints' chapel
saints.alt: A bright saints' chapel on pilgrimage day, full of red roses. On the left an old painting shows a crowd under a banner of a young priest, and a tapestry shows the bearded gardener monk with a golden halo; a pilgrim with a scallop shell stands by the door and a mime in a red beret vacuums up rose petals. In the middle one mime hangs a silver heart on a wall of hearts, another preaches with a finger raised, standing on a wooden crate, a tiny old nun beside the crate holds out a rose, and a third mime bows with his hand on his heart. On the right an old man smells a rose with a blissful smile, the monk's statue stands in a flowered niche shrine, a pilgrim arrives with a staff, and a stained-glass window shows an archangel. The arched door on the left goes back to the Mercy chapel.

doors.label: La Miséricorde
doors.hint: The low arched door on the left, back to the Mercy chapel

portail.name: Le portail du cimetière · The churchyard gate
portail.alt: A calm, sunny afternoon at the far end of the churchyard. On the left a small table holds an open book and white lilies, and a few adults in dark clothes stand quietly holding white flowers; white doves sit on the low wall. In the middle a mime in a shiny gold beret gathers fallen lilies into a bouquet. On the right a grave site is covered with a green cloth and ringed with flower wreaths, a closed wooden casket covered in white roses rests on a wheeled stand, a young deacon in a white alb reads from an open book by the gatepost, and a dark hearse waits with its back door open by the open iron gate. The gravel path on the left goes back through the churchyard, and the gate on the right leads out to the village.

doors.label: Le cimetière
doors.hint: The gravel path on the left, back through the churchyard
